name: Methoxyflurane

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States, first in 2001 — for liver harm and kidney harm

summary: Methoxyflurane was removed from the market in the United States starting in 2001 due to harm caused to the liver and kidneys [3]. In addition, a small computer model evaluated the drug rather than tests on people, assigning it a low score of 18 for liver risk [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a low score of 23 for heart risk [M].
